instructions: When an initiative is absent, list all pending communications, pause the graph, and request one initiative from the user.
When an initiative is supplied, list only its pending communications.
Execute in Latest mode using the selected initiative domain.
Execute this job twice in sequence using the selected initiative domain: first in Latest mode, then in default mode.
If latest mode fails because there is no latest output, continue with default mode and create a new one.
Use the latest follow-up and communication outputs as inputs to the default-mode execution.
Draft every open communication task for the initiative.
